primaryChecks.text: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
primaryChecks.previousContext: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He was very thirsty, and called on the LORD and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”
